summary: Learn practical prompt engineering for content teams, with templates, testing, and brand-safe workflows. Enrol now.
lede: Prompt Engineering for Writing, Marketing and Comms teaches you to specify roles, context, constraints, tone, and output formats so large language models produce more usable drafts with fewer revisions. You will apply these methods to marketing copy, internal communications, and editorial workflows. The course covers prompt design, output assessment, prompt iteration, reusable templates, and structured content revision. Through lab exercises, prompt comparisons, and revision drills, you will practise creating consistent drafts that align with a brand brief or campaign objective while fitting real approval and production workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already create, review, or approve content and now need a more reliable prompt engineering for writing, marketing and comms workflow.
modules: Prompt Libraries and AI Content Governance
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites include working knowledge of writing, marketing, or corporate communications workflows; familiarity with common content formats such as emails, landing pages, social posts, briefs, or campaign copy; and basic confidence using a generative AI tool such as ChatGPT or similar LLM interface. No coding is required, and advanced prompt engineering concepts will be taught at the operational application level rather than technical engineering depth. You should be ready to bring a laptop and sample content tasks from your role so you can practice prompt design, revision, and quality review during the course.
